name: Tetra Master

env.name: POL_TM_ZONE_HOST
env.description: Address a Tetra Master client dials for its zones. Empty: POL_ADVERTISE.

env.name: POL_TM_EVENT_START
env.description: Event window start, unix seconds (-1 = no event).

env.name: POL_TM_EVENT_END
env.description: Event window end, unix seconds (-1 = no event).

env.name: POL_TM_EVENT_ZONE_MEMBERS
env.description: Members who get the tournament zone (comma list of member ids, or *). Empty: no tournaments.

env.name: POL_TM_EVENT_WINDOW
env.description: A fixed daily UTC tournament window, "HH:MM-HH:MM".

env.name: POL_TM_EVENT_DECK_PICK
env.description: The tournament's entry card picker: 1 = everyone.

env.name: POL_TM_EVENT_DECK_PICK_MEMBERS
env.description: Members who get the card picker.

env.name: TM_RANK_AT
env.description: "now" publishes the ranking lists at start as well as weekly.

env.name: POL_BOARDS_TM_URL
env.description: Live board: the public URL Discord messages link to.

env.name: POL_BOARDS_TM_DISCORD_WEBHOOK
env.description: Live board: webhook for the standings.

env.name: POL_BOARDS_TM_AUCTION_DISCORD_WEBHOOK
env.description: Live board: webhook for auction listings.

data.description: The four parameter tables (cards, prices, computer opponents, packs) and the title ladder.
data.source: your Tetra Master install (the Viewer's SquareEnix/TetraMaster directory)

import.label: card tables
import.hint: your Tetra Master install: the TetraMaster folder in the SquareEnix folder of your PlayOnline install, the one holding data/

data.description: Card and board art for the live board (--profile board).

import.label: board art
import.hint: your Tetra Master PC install: the TetraMaster folder in the SquareEnix folder of your PlayOnline install, the one holding data/gW000.dat

notes: No port of its own: the game rides the core's login and authsess processes as the tmtitle plugin. Its image is the base for the weekly tmrank job and the board.
